mapper.select: SELECT n.*, m.stock_name as stockName FROM user_note n LEFT JOIN stock_master m ON n.ref_code = m.stock_code WHERE n.USRID = #{usrId} ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.created_at DESC
SELECT n.*, m.stock_name as stockName FROM user_note n LEFT JOIN stock_master m ON n.ref_code = m.stock_code WHERE n.USRID = #{usrId} AND n.ref_code = #{refCode} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
SELECT n.*, m.stock_name as stockName FROM user_note n LEFT JOIN stock_master m ON n.ref_code = m.stock_code WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.USRID = #{usrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_note ( USRID, ref_code, stock_name, title, content, category, is_important, view_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{usrId}, #{refCode}, (SELECT MAX(stock_name) FROM stock_master WHERE stock_code = #{refCode}), #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{isImportant}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_note SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, ref_code = #{refCode}, stock_name = (SELECT MAX(stock_name) FROM stock_master WHERE stock_code = #{refCode}), category = #{category}, is_important = #{isImportant}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND USRID = #{usrId}
UPDATE user_note SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_note WHERE id = #{id} AND USRID = #{usrId}
